lessons.title: A PDF is also a recipe

blocks.body: You just named today's job. Now the idea: A PDF is also a recipe. Then you will do the lab.

blocks.heading: A PDF is also a recipe
blocks.body:
A **PDF** is a print-style file the engine builds from your booklet.

**Chemistry** is a PDF tool some teams use :  if you do not have it, skip and write why.

Name the tool. Put the file in `out-pdf/`. Check one fact (the warning). Stop.

If the tool is not installed, the log says so. That line is a valid lab outcome. Do not download a random add-on off a blog.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: One PDF, named tool.

This lab can fail. Fail when: You ship a screenshot of someone else’s PDF as yours, or you dump output into topics/, or you claim a tool name the log does not use.

Expected: pdf-engine.txt names the tool or the missing-tool message. Output path outside source. Warning presence noted if a PDF exists.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to One PDF, named tool.
blocks.intro: How to One PDF, named tool. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: One PDF, named tool
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: In Configure Transformation Scenario, filter DITA Map PDF. Pick the recipe your install ships (PDF :  based on HTML5 & CSS, Chemistry, or another PDF recipe :  verify the name).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: If SUCCESS, open the PDF. Write: tool name, page count, whether the pinch warning appears.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Chemistry is a PDF tool some teams use :  if you do not have it, skip and write why. If any PDF recipe is missing, write the missing-tool message in oxygen-bootcamp-work/week6/pdf-engine.txt. That message is the lab, not a fake PDF.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Do not install a random look to ‘make it pretty’. Do not treat this as a layout app.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Keep the PDF out of the source booklet folder.

blocks.summary: pdf-engine.txt names the tool or the missing-tool message. Output path outside source. Warning presence noted if a PDF exists.

blocks.body: The lab is done. Prove it with the check. Use words from today only.

blocks.q: Why write the PDF tool’s name?
options: The log and the missing-tool errors use that name; ‘the PDF button’ is not a diagnosis
blocks.why: This week is log literacy. Tools have names.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: The PDF dropped your table borders. First move today?
options: Rewrite the table as a picture
Write it down; check whether the table is clean first. Do not start a look career this afternoon
Switch the whole book to a notepad file
blocks.why: Validity and recipe choice first. Look comes later, and not from you this week.
